_comment: Copied to config.json by setup_machine.py, which then fills in `roots`. Every key is optional.
_roots: Folders whose subfolders are your projects. Empty means the folder this checkout sits in.

streamdeck._comment: Projects pinned to fixed keys, in order. Anything live and unpinned fills the rest.

background._comment: Options for `claude --bg`. Omit a key to use your own settings.

voice._comment: Dictation (F9). Local GPU; nothing leaves the machine. Needs the voice extras (setup_machine.py --voice). preload keeps ~2GB of VRAM busy.

remote._comment: Sessions on other machines, polled over SSH (key auth). Example host: {"name": "devbox", "claude": "$HOME/.local/bin/claude", "tunnel": true}

notify._comment: When a session is still waiting on you after `delay` seconds. Both off; the Insights view switches them on and off at runtime. ntfy sends only 'project: reason' to https://<server>/<topic> - on ntfy.sh the topic name is the only secret, so pick an unguessable one.

budget._comment: Rate-limit percentages that raise an event (and a push/speech when those are on), once per window. Needs the statusline: python hooks/install.py --statusline
